text: 上海财经大学校长刘元春9月19日在清华五道口首席经济学家论坛上表示，扩内需是我国的长期战略，而非短期的政策选择，是逆周期与跨周期相结合的战略，本质上超越了简单的短期调控范畴。消费疲软若源于结构性因素而非单纯的周期性因素，仅靠积极财政政策和宽松货币政策是难以根本解决。当前中国经济正处于从传统“投资+出口”驱动型，向创新驱动型模式的转型关键期。在模式转型过程中，目前的供求关系不平衡应该是常态，但这个时候如果过度追求短期平衡，恰恰会失去穿越周期的能力。
text_en: Liu Yuanchun, president of Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, said on September 19 at the Tsinghua PBCSF Chief Economists Forum that expanding domestic demand is China's long-term strategy rather than a short-term policy choice, and is a strategy combining countercyclical and cross-cyclical measures, essentially going beyond the scope of simple short-term regulation. If weak consumption stems from structural factors rather than purely cyclical factors, it will be difficult to fundamentally solve the problem with proactive fiscal policy and accommodative monetary policy alone. The Chinese economy is currently in a critical period of transition from the traditional "investment + export" driven model to an innovation-driven model. During the model transition, the current imbalance between supply and demand should be the norm, but at this time, if there is excessive pursuit of short-term balance, it will precisely lose the ability to ride through cycles.
